name: CATCHA
recent: CATCHA 近期主要涉及私募配售的进展，以及集团首席执行官的股份交易。公司于8月获得交易所批准，将最多10%已发行股份的私募配售完成期限延长6个月至2027年2月6日。此外，集团首席执行官在8月至10月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
notable: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension for the company to complete its private placement of up to 10% of issued shares, now due by 6 February 2027.。
Group CEO Eric Tan Leong Yit acquired a total of 108,000 ordinary shares across three transactions in August and October 2026.。
risks: The private placement of up to 10% of existing issued shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity upon completion.。
The private placement has been outstanding since 2025 and its completion deadline has been extended to 6 February 2027.。

recent_en: CATCHA's recent developments mainly involve the progress of its private placement and share dealings by the Group CEO. The company obtained Bursa Securities' approval in August to extend the completion deadline for the private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares by 6 months to 6 February 2027. In addition, the Group CEO acquired shares in the open market on several occasions between August and October.
notable_en: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension for the company to complete its private placement of up to 10% of issued shares, now due by 6 February 2027.
Group CEO Eric Tan Leong Yit acquired a total of 108,000 ordinary shares across three transactions in August and October 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% of existing issued shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity upon completion.
The private placement has been outstanding since 2025 and its completion deadline has been extended to 6 February 2027.
